name: Engineering contract draft review
type: AM Platform / contracts / LINE group review
scope: Immutable draft-review evidence and V2/V3 revision history
requiresDatabases: Existing Engineering Drive root and project Group Bindings

dataIsolation.guard: Each review resolves one Engineering contract version and that contract project's active LINE group; tokens are stored only as SHA-256 digests.

changes: Allow an incomplete draft with a contract body to be sent for discussion
Generate a visibly watermarked non-signable PDF and public review page
Record LINE send, first open, reviewer identity, decision, notes, time, IP, and user agent
Keep draft-review evidence separate from formal electronic-signing evidence
Display review history in the graphical Engineering AM contract workspace
definitionOfDone: Schema v3 and restricted runtime grants are applied
Draft review, contract workflow, and PDF regression dry runs pass
Production public review route and internal contract UI are verified
No real LINE message is sent without an operator-selected contract and group
